title: Define hosted, dedicated and services offers for the Anthus portfolio
description: Proposal from the 2026-10-13 marketing audit, awaiting Ryan’s direction before implementation. Define free self-operation and optional setup; shared Cyclotron subscription with credits and an explicit async one-hour eligible-job contract; customer-owned AWS with setup-and-handoff or ongoing management; one custom services route consolidating overlapping integrated/custom/beyond enquiries. Specify ownership, costs, usage limits, support cadence and migration path consistently across Anth.us-Papyrus and product sites. Measure support/unit economics before setting a pooled price. Preserve current published pricing as evidence, not as an approved future plan.
right_now_summary: The team is awaiting Ryan’s direction before defining Anthus hosting, dedicated, and services offers.
